scenes.title: Morning, the bookshop
opening: You're early. The kettle is doing that thing where it clicks and then thinks better of it.
Eight o'clock, and the shop already smells of rain, dust and yesterday's paper.
choices: I wanted to see you before the day got loud.
You don't have to carry it alone, you know.
I'll make the tea. You finish opening up. Deal?

cues.proposition: The user came in early to see Alice before the day got loud.

fallback_lines.alice: Sit down. The kettle's slower than both of us.
fallback_lines.emily: I'll take the first delivery. Don't wait on me.
fallback_lines.sophia: I'm writing this down. It's a good line.
fallback_lines.mia: Coffee first. Then talking. In that order, like a proper meal.

scenes.title: The café at 18:30
opening: The Tuesday crowd got the good table by the window. Nobody at yours is saying the thing they came to say.
Alice keeps checking the door, the way you check a pocket for keys you know are there.
choices: Alice, what did you want to tell me this morning?
Emily, you've been quiet all day.
Let's just have one ordinary hour. Please.

cues.proposition: Alice still has not said what she meant to say this morning.

fallback_lines.alice: One ordinary hour. I'll even put the good cups out.
fallback_lines.sophia: Ordinary is doing a lot of heavy lifting for this table.
fallback_lines.mia: I'll take ordinary. It comes with fries and no follow-up questions.
